form.notes: Form-associated (`ElementInternals`): submits `name=2026-03-21T14:30` (an empty string when empty) whatever the language, calendar or time zone, resets to the `value` attribute, restores on navigation, and joins `<fieldset disabled>`. `required` (valueMissing: a date without a time is not a value), `min`/`max` (rangeUnderflow / rangeOverflow), `dateConstraints` (a custom error) and text that is not a date or a time (badInput) block the submit; the error shows after the user acted or a submit attempt, and unreadable text once typing pauses.

differences.text: Uncontrolled by default (D-006): `value` is a plain string with the `value` attribute as its default (a form reset restores it), and native `input`/`change` events report a committed change instead of a controlled `value` plus `onChange`. The value is one string `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]`; both parts submit and read back the same whatever the locale, calendar or time zone.

Typed text in either part is a draft that commits when its part is left or Enter is pressed (see DATEINPUT-02). A time typed or chosen before any date is held and shown, then combined with the date chosen after it (upstream only holds it for the native controls); choosing a date takes the current time (moved inside `min`/`max` on their own day). Emptying the date clears the whole value; emptying the time only reverts it.

Text that is not a date or a time is `validity.badInput`, `aria-invalid` and announced once assertively after typing pauses, instead of two always-mounted `role=alert` nodes; the time part carries its own `aria-invalid`.

`min`/`max`/`dateConstraints` are also constraints on the value (rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, a custom error); `statusVariant` is not offered (the message is always the detached one, as upstream); an `open` property and the cancelable `tct-open-change` / `tct-after-open-change` events expose the calendar popover and the sheet; `tct-clear` is cancelable.

The touch sheet is a bottom sheet with Date and Time tabs (a segmented control): the Date tab holds the one-month calendar (a pick commits and stays), the Time tab hour, minute, second and AM/PM columns (`tct-time-panel`, listboxes that commit live); "Save date" moves to the Time tab and "Save" closes. Upstream's swipe-paged date wheels are not reproduced. The native surface is two real inputs with painted text; the upstream per-part fallbacks (seconds, a `time-increment` other than 1, `time-option-interval`) keep the typed time part except under an explicit `presentation="native"`.

Two outlined boxes (the date box wider than the time box) share one row and wrap on a narrow field; the time list uses the muted accent wash for the picked time and the tertiary hover roles for the highlight, with a heavier weight on the picked time so colour is not the only cue.

core.date-time-input.notes: Guides: [mwg:model-partial-time-concepts] a wall-clock date-time with no zone; [mwg:capture-location-agnostic-data]; [mwg:support-global-calendar-systems]; [mwg:validate-input-after-interaction]; [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements]; [mwg:ime-safe-enter-submit]; [mwg:accessible-error-announcement]. The preset-time list is an ARIA 1.2 combobox with a listbox popup (aria-activedescendant, focus stays in the input).
